name: Military Press (Barbell)
instructions: Hold a barbell at your upper chest with an overhand grip just outside shoulder width, feet together or hip-width.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your core.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly then forward.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar under control to your chest.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A strict standing barbell overhead press without leg drive, building shoulder and triceps strength.
